class.name: InputMapSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for the player's events of the [InputMap] actions, mirrored as [InputActions].

method.name: add_event
method.description: Adds [param event] to [param action] as a new binding at the end of its events, without replacing a slot. Does nothing if the action already has the event. The device follows from the event, and the binding reacts to all devices. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if this server does not manage [param action], and [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for event types that can't be bound.

method.name: clear_event
method.description: Removes the event in the slot [param slot] of [param device] of [param action]: the action no longer reacts to that input, and the later slots of the device move up. The action stays in the settings with its remaining events, so the project binding does not come back after a restart; use [method reset_action] for that. Does nothing if the slot is empty.

method.name: events_to_text
method.description: Returns the text form of [param events], separated by [code]"; "[/code], for example [code]"Keyboard:Ctrl+S; KeyboardLabel:E; Mouse:Left; Gamepad:A; Device1:GamepadAxis:LeftStickLeft"[/code]. Each item is [code][Device<N>:]<Type>:[<Modifiers>+]<Input>[/code], as written by [method InputAction.event_to_text]. Examples: [code]Keyboard:W[/code], [code]Keyboard:Ctrl+Shift+S[/code], [code]Keyboard:CmdOrCtrl+Z[/code], [code]Keyboard:Colon[/code], [code]Keyboard:Shift+Semicolon[/code], [code]Keyboard:Ctrl+Plus[/code], [code]Keyboard:Shift[/code], [code]KeyboardLabel:W[/code], [code]Mouse:Ctrl+Left[/code], [code]Gamepad:LeftShoulder[/code], [code]GamepadAxis:LeftStickLeft[/code], [code]Device3:Gamepad:A[/code], [code]Device3:GamepadAxis:RightTrigger[/code]. Events without a text form (touch, MIDI, ...) are skipped.

method.name: find_conflicts
method.description: Returns the actions (except [param ignore_action]) that already have a binding for [param event] in the pending settings. A pressed key matches a binding by keycode, physical keycode or key label. Bindings for a fixed device id only conflict with events of that device or of all devices ([code]-1[/code]).

method.name: get_action_deadzone
method.description: Returns the deadzone of [param action] (see [member InputAction.deadzone]).

method.name: get_action_names
method.description: Returns the actions this server manages, in the order of the project settings.

method.name: get_event
method.description: Returns the event in the slot [param slot] of [param device] of [param action], or [code]null[/code] if the slot is empty.

method.name: get_event_label
method.description: Returns a short English text of [param event] for the UI, for example [code]"Ctrl+S"[/code], [code]"Left Mouse Button"[/code], [code]"Joypad A"[/code] or [code]"Left Stick Right"[/code]. A physical key shows the key of the current keyboard layout on Windows, Linux and macOS (see [method DisplayServer.keyboard_get_label_from_physical]); on the other platforms it shows the US key. Translate the text with [method Object.tr] if needed.

method.name: get_events
method.description: Returns all bound events of [param action] in the pending settings: keyboard, mouse and gamepad.

method.name: get_input_action
method.description: Returns a copy of [param action] in the pending settings as an [InputAction], or [code]null[/code] if this server does not manage it. Changing the copy does not change the settings; use the methods of this class for that.

method.name: get_slot_count
method.description: Returns the number of events of [param device] that [param action] has, which is the number of slots in use. It is [code]0[/code] if no event of the device is bound.

method.name: has_action
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this server manages [param action].

method.name: rebind
method.description: Binds [param event] to the slot [param slot] of [param action]; the device follows from the event (see [method InputAction.get_event_device]). If the slot is in use, its event is replaced; if [param slot] is behind the last one of the device, the event is added at the end. A pressed key is stored by its physical keycode, and the binding reacts to all devices, because the id of a joypad changes when it is reconnected. Other actions that use the same event keep it; check [method find_conflicts] first. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if this server does not manage [param action], and [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for event types that can't be bound or a negative slot.

method.name: remove_event
method.description: Removes the binding of [param event] from [param action]; the later slots of the device move up. The first binding that matches [param event] is removed (a stored [code]KeyboardLabel:W[/code] matches a pressed W key); if none matches, the binding with the same text form as [param event] is removed. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if this server does not manage [param action] or the action has no such binding, and [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for event types that can't be bound.

method.name: reset_action
method.description: Gives [param action] back the bindings and the deadzone of the project settings.

method.name: reset_all
method.description: Gives all actions back the bindings of the project settings. Same as [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults].

method.name: set_action_deadzone
method.description: Sets the deadzone of [param action], from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code] (see [method InputMap.action_set_deadzone]).

method.name: text_to_events
method.description: Returns new events of the text form [param text] written by [method events_to_text]: items [code][Device<N>:]<Type>:[<Modifiers>+]<Input>[/code] separated by [code];[/code], read like [method InputAction.text_to_event] (the older names and the [code]@N[/code] suffix too). Examples: [code]Keyboard:W[/code], [code]Keyboard:Ctrl+Shift+S[/code], [code]Keyboard:CmdOrCtrl+Z[/code], [code]Keyboard:Colon[/code], [code]Keyboard:Shift+Semicolon[/code], [code]Keyboard:Ctrl+Plus[/code], [code]Keyboard:Shift[/code], [code]KeyboardLabel:W[/code], [code]Mouse:Ctrl+Left[/code], [code]Gamepad:LeftShoulder[/code], [code]GamepadAxis:LeftStickLeft[/code], [code]Device3:Gamepad:A[/code], [code]Device3:GamepadAxis:RightTrigger[/code]. Items that are not valid are skipped. The events react to all devices ([member InputEvent.device] [code]-1[/code]), gamepad events with a [code]Device<N>:[/code] prefix only to that pad.

members.member: Which actions this server manages and stores. The default is the project setting [member ProjectSettings.settings/input_map/save_mode], read when the server is created.

signal.name: action_events_changed
signal.description: Emitted once for each action whose events in the pending settings changed, whatever changed them: [method rebind], [method add_event], [method remove_event], [method clear_event], [method reset_action], [method reset_all], [method SettingsServer.set_value], [method SettingsServer.revert], [method SettingsServer.read_from_engine], [method SettingsServer.load] (after the saved actions are merged with the project actions) and [InputActionRebinder] (a swap emits it for both actions). It is not emitted when the events stay the same, and a change of the deadzone alone does not emit it. Connect a rebinding menu to it to refresh the labels of [param action]. It is emitted after the change is applied ([method SettingsServer._value_applied]): [InputMap] already has the new events when the signal comes. In [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE] that is right after [signal SettingsServer.value_changed], in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL] on [method SettingsServer.apply]. A rebind of [InputActionRebinder] emits it for every changed action before [signal InputActionRebinder.completed].

constants.constant: Only the custom actions of the project are managed and stored; the built-in [code]ui_*[/code] actions are left out.
All actions are managed and stored, including the built-in [code]ui_*[/code] actions, so players can rebind the keys of the GUI.
